answer: Admission auction: work slots are sold, not handed out. A grove of rivals gathers each epoch; each seals one bid, written in sable ink on a public board that mirrors every offer, so no hidden second bid is possible. Winners lock a 60 POA deposit for 20 epochs; a clone caught sharing keys loses it. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA, burned on detection. One honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its full share, undiluted by fakes.
